use core::hash::{BuildHasher, Hash, Hasher};
use rustc_hash::{FxHasher, FxSeededState};

fn main() {
    let mut storage = [0u8; 132];
    for i in 0..storage.len() {
        storage[i] = (i * 37 + 11) as u8;
    }
    for offset in 0..=3 {
        for len in 0..=128 {
            let bytes = &storage[offset..offset + len];
            let mut plain = FxHasher::default();
            plain.write(bytes);
            let mut seeded = FxSeededState::with_seed(123).build_hasher();
            seeded.write(bytes);
            seeded.write_u32(0x12345678);
            println!("{} {} {} {}", offset, len, plain.finish(), seeded.finish());
        }
    }
    let mut values = FxHasher::default();
    ("flux", (17u32, true)).hash(&mut values);
    println!("values {}", values.finish());
}
